user.title: Yutai Bluetooth Socket
user.description: Enter the address, model and key shown by the QR tool. The socket will be read to verify these details before it is added.

data_description.name: Choose a name (1–80 characters), such as Living room socket.
data_description.address: Copy the Bluetooth MAC from the QR tool, in the format XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX.
data_description.model: Use the model shown by the QR tool: fsov8m is the metering model; fsov7m is the standard model.
data_description.gatt_ltmk: Paste the key copied by the QR tool: 64 hexadecimal characters (32 bytes).

error.invalid_config: Check the name, Bluetooth MAC, model and key. The key must contain 64 hexadecimal characters.
error.cannot_connect: Could not verify a Bluetooth read. Check the socket's power, Bluetooth range, model and key. Close its Mi Home control page or turn off the phone's Bluetooth, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This socket is already configured. Find it under Settings > Devices & services.
abort.invalid_config: Check the name, Bluetooth MAC, model and key. The key must contain 64 hexadecimal characters.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not verify a Bluetooth read. Check the socket's power, Bluetooth range, model and key. Close its Mi Home control page or turn off the phone's Bluetooth, then try again.

init.title: Polling
init.description: Set how often the socket state is read automatically.

data_description.poll_interval: Default: 60 seconds. Range: 30–3600 seconds. Lower values refresh the state more frequently.
data_description.session_idle_timeout: Metering model only. 0 disables reuse; 1-120 retains an idle connection. 90 seconds can cover 60-second polling. Mi Home direct Bluetooth may be unavailable while connected. Sessions renew after 300 seconds or 64 requests.

error.invalid_interval: Enter an integer from 30 to 3600 seconds, for example 60.
error.invalid_session_timeout: Enter an integer from 0 to 120 seconds.

invalid_countdown_duration.message: Enter 1-59 seconds, or whole minutes from 60 to 86340 seconds (23 h 59 min).

read_unverified.message: Yutai BLE read could not be verified

unsupported_setting.message: This setting or value is not supported by the Yutai BLE device.

setting_unverified.message: Yutai BLE setting could not be verified

invalid_relay_value.message: Yutai BLE output requires a boolean value

relay_unverified.message: Yutai BLE output could not be verified; readback will check its state

relay_cancelled.message: Yutai BLE output request was cancelled

invalid_local_time.message: Yutai BLE time requires a local whole minute
